attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 30 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry enumerates four of its members and not the other thirteen, so it is four folders and one unnamed company: the thirteen are named nowhere and get no folder. The display name takes the companion the page's own epigram pairs him with, «Eις τον Aλέξανδρον και Kρονίωνα», because the corpus keeps a dozen Alexanders. The Macarius of this company is not the corpus's Macarius of Alexandria, who is a monk and presbyter with a Greek feast on 19 January. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
